items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: Then I started out with my brothers, Oivin and Longin. And Lawrence threw it. Oivin was a great trombonist.

ctx.x: He doesn't teach you. I think it's in the 20s. That's right. It's the early 20s, I think.
Then I started out with my brothers, Oivin and Longin. And Lawrence threw it. Oivin was a great trombonist. Lawrence was a trumpet, very good trumpet player and music arranger.
So you've always been in family bands most of the time. That's right. Still have you.
